_about: Public setup. Copy this file to mineru_plus.json (git-ignored) or pass --config PATH. Each role names a backend and its options. Credentials are named by environment variables (api_key_env) and never written here. The base_url and model values are placeholders for the service you run.
_primary_note: primary_reader runs mineru-kit (the mineru package, MinerU 4.x) on this machine and does not call mineru.net unless extra_args has --remote. Install it in its own environment, e.g. uv pip install 'mineru>=4.0,<5', and set command to its path if it is not on PATH. The first parse may download models.
